title: Chubby Hero Quest
description: Join plucky Chubby Hero on a lively 3D adventure packed with bouncy platforms, coin trails, and cheeky monsters guarding every milestone.
controls: Drag or swipe to steer, jump across moving platforms, collect coins, and clear each adventure stage.

zh-CN.title: 胖奥的冒险
zh-CN.description: 魔性欢乐 3D 动作闯关胖奥的冒险：陪呆萌胖奥翻山越岭躲陷阱、拾金币打小怪，开启轻松解压的奇幻冒险之旅！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动或滑动控制胖奥移动与跳跃，躲开沿途机关小怪收集金币一路闯关。
